_doc: Reference-plate manifest for Sweetgum (Liquidambar styraciflua). Stage-0 source list; binaries download in Stage-1 ingest (downloaded:false). Jacob ratifies identification (ratified:false).
identityNotes: Unmistakable 5–7-pointed STAR-shaped leaf, arranged ALTERNATELY (unlike maples' opposite), plus spiky 'gumball' fruit and corky-winged twigs. Aromatic when crushed.

plates.caption: Pyramidal-to-oval crown of glossy star-shaped leaves.
Multi-color autumn canopy (yellow/orange/red/purple), the star leaf shape clear.
Deeply furrowed grey-brown bark; corky-winged twigs and spiky gumballs in related files.
